I can't confirm the `just` recipe name from this checkout. There's no justfile here, and `Makefile` is still present, so the removal isn't in this branch.

The old `Makefile` defined the fast target like this:

```
test-fast:
	pytest -m "not postgres" -q
```

So the fast tests are:

```
pytest -m "not postgres" -q
```

This skips the integration tests marked `postgres`. Those need a real database (`docker compose up db`), which is why the fast run avoids them. The full suite is plain `pytest -q`.

If your `just test` recipe forwards arguments, `just test -m "not postgres"` may work. Otherwise, check the justfile on your branch for something like `test-fast`.

The stored "Test command" memory still says `make test-fast` and `make test`. I haven't changed it, because I can't see the `just` recipes. If you tell me the new recipe names, I'll update it.
